pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   C. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.

5. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. C — The speed of the music

3. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elements of Music RESPONDING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
